summary: Iteration 7 (RBAC + attachment hard-delete) — 21/21 new tests + 95/95 full backend regression pass. Backend: TestTaskRBAC (member list only related, admin list all, get 403 unrelated, get related 200, delete not-owned 403, PIC PUT status returns 200 (allowed) though auto-recomputed, PIC PUT title stripped -> title unchanged, admin PUT title changes it). TestMeetingRBAC (member list only meetings created-by-member or where member.name in participants, admin list all, get 403 unrelated, member DELETE 403, member PUT 403). TestNotesRBAC (everyone can list & GET all notes shared, member PUT/DELETE other's note -> 403, member CRUD on own note works). TestDashboardScoping (admin.total_tasks >= member.total_tasks+1, admin.total_meetings >= member+1, /calendar admin sees unrel task+meeting but member does not). TestAttachmentHardDelete (upload file to task via multipart, DELETE /api/attachments/{id} -> 200, GET task/attachments no longer lists it AND record truly gone from db.files not just is_deleted; soft-delete parent task -> appears in /api/archive; DELETE /api/archive/task/{id} purges parent + cascades deletes attachment records). Frontend E2E: Member (member@flowdesk.com) — sidebar hides ALL 7 Menu Admin items (Kelola Aplikasi/Peranan/Pengguna/Database/Notifikasi/Arsip/Log Aktivitas) but shows Menu Utama fully. On a task where member is PIC (not creator): btn-edit-task and btn-delete-task both hidden (count=0); checklist items still fully interactive (toggle works). Kelola Catatan: on a note owned by admin — btn-delete-note-{id} hidden, opening dialog shows 'hanya dapat dilihat' hint and btn-save-note absent (read-only). Admin regression: sidebar shows all Menu Admin items incl Arsip, opens task detail with both edit+delete buttons, /archive route accessible. Data cleanup complete; member account preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/tasks.py update_task: when non-full non-PIC user has NO allowed fields in payload, returns 403 with detail 'Sebagai PIC Anda hanya dapat memperbarui progres, status, dan checklist'. But when a PIC sends a mix of allowed+disallowed fields (e.g., {title,status}), disallowed fields are silently stripped without any warning field in response. Consider returning a 'stripped_fields' info key so the frontend can surface which changes were ignored — right now the UI thinks title update succeeded until it re-reads.

routers/tasks.py update_task: the PIC-limited whitelist {'items','documents','status'} does NOT include 'description' — arguably a PIC should be able to add progress notes/description. Confirm with product; if intended, current behavior is correct.

routers/notes.py list_notes: notes are SHARED-VIEW globally (any logged-in user sees all), which is consistent with request. But GET /notes/{id} has NO visibility check (unlike tasks/meetings). A member could enumerate note IDs (via list, which they can see anyway) — low risk but the endpoint is inconsistent with tasks.py/meetings.py which do check visibility. Not a bug per current spec (notes are shared), just noting the divergence.

routers/aggregate.py /calendar: reminders filter is 'created_by: user.id' (correct — reminders are private), but there's no is_deleted guard on the events collection query result being scoped per-user (custom events are globally visible to everyone). Confirm intent.

routers/archive.py purge_item: cascade deletes ALL files with parent_id=item_id, but does NOT cascade-delete child tasks generated from a meeting (meeting_id link). If admin purges a meeting, tasks created via convert_action_item are orphaned (meeting_id/meeting_title point to a nonexistent meeting). Consider either detaching (meeting_id=None) or cascading.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all member RBAC UI + admin regression flows)

seed_data_creation: Test data created & cleaned within pytest fixtures (TEST_iter7_* prefix). During E2E, temporarily seeded 1 task (SEED_iter7_e2e_member_pic with member as PIC) + 1 admin-owned note (SEED_iter7_admin_note_readonly) — both hard-purged after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC helpers: helpers.is_privileged(user) checks role in {admin,manager}; helpers.can_manage(user,doc) returns admin OR doc.created_by==user.id. Task visibility for non-privileged: created_by OR pic.user_id OR requester.user_id matches uid. Meeting visibility: created_by OR user.name in participants (NOTE: name-based, so if a user is renamed their meeting participation link may break). Notes are globally viewable but edit/delete restricted to creator/admin. Reminders are strictly private to created_by. Attachment DELETE /api/attachments/{id} is a HARD delete (removes storage_path via storage.delete_object and db.files.delete_one, NOT is_deleted flag). Archive purge cascades files via delete_many({parent_id: item_id}). PIC (non-creator) PUT /tasks/{id} silently strips disallowed fields (title/priority/pic/requester/deadline/description) — assertion must check field unchanged rather than expecting 400. Task.status may be auto-recomputed from progress in compute() unless it's Draft/Cancelled/Archived — tests must not assume status echoes back verbatim.
